notes: 'as for' is given to the resumptive waw of וַיִּמְאֲסוּ, which is the morpheme the fronting construction turns on; the competing reading marks that waw unrepresented and calls 'as for' added.
The clause's two waws are counted against the ASV's 'and' and 'as for', so neither is added; the appositional 'even' has no אֵת and no conjunction behind it and is added.
Both articles of הָעָם הַזֶּה are unrepresented because the phrase's single determiner is the demonstrative, which זֶה licenses (rule 41).
